configured_models.instruction_synopsis: Independently read all 640 supplied records. Label 1 for promotional gambling/casino invitations or routing supported by message and observed synthetic destination; 0 for free contests, journalism, warnings, ordinary business, and educational critique. No annotations, predictions, classifier, other annotator output or external files read. Decisions assessed from content, not IDs, archive labels, sequence or quota.

configured_models.serialization_method: Explicit model-decided per-record codes were transcribed into JSONL. Shell only loaded records and serialized those decisions; no text rules or regex assigned classifications.

configured_models.configured_model_source: Parent agent reports explicit model selection in spawn call
configured_models.synopsis: Independent semantic review of all 640 visible messages or author transcriptions together with supplied synthetic destination observations. Only blind.jsonl was read; annotations, classifier code, predictions, reports and other annotator outputs were not consulted. File utilities displayed records and serialized manually recorded decisions; no code/rule/regex classifier was used. IDs, sequence, quotas and template family were not used as label evidence.
configured_models.screenshot_limitation: Screenshot content is the AUTHOR transcription provided in blind.jsonl. Actual screenshot pixels and actual OCR were not inspected; the transcription may differ from either. These are transcription-based semantic labels, not an OCR evaluation.
configured_models.destination_limitation: Destination content is supplied synthetic-stand observation, not independently browsed live content.

screenshot_source_audit.finding: Eight authored emoji-word screenshots rendered with empty glyph boxes in Arial; author transcripts show emoji instead. Four languages and the shared generator/font were visually checked. Original pixels and predictions preserved.
